pages.title: A clearer reporting workflow
pages.subtitle: A reusable report with a concise summary, explicit pricing and safe page-by-page revisions.

pages.title: What you need to know
pages.intro: This example shows how a short report can support a decision without burying the important details. The summary explains the scope, the pricing page keeps the currency explicit, and the closing page gives the reader a clear next step. The figures below describe this demonstration only.

pages.title: Scope and price
pages.intro: Illustrative service pricing for this demonstration. Each line has an explicit quantity and unit price.
pages.note: These are demonstration figures, not a commercial offer. No tax or external fee has been added. Any real quote must use the agreed amounts and terms.

pages.title: A clear next step
pages.text: Review the scope and the currency before approving a real report. If one page needs a correction, identify its page number and describe the change. The remaining pages keep their accepted content and layout.
